C. Kalamazoo, Michigan
Site Developer: Kalamazoo BREAKTHROUGH Housing Venture Site Planner: Perkins & Will Partnership of Michigan
Housing Mix: 52 MFHR
52 MFLR 127 SFA 14 SFD
Ownership Pattern: Cooperative, some subsidized.
This is a 33.8 acre suburban site located on a plateau overlooking a lake in Spring Valley Regional park within the Kalamazoo city limits. The park adjoining the site is open in character with well-drained plateau areas, long down-hill slopes, wetland areas with a dense cover of low shrubs, and a thick tree cover on the slopes adjacent to the lake.
The site plan provides two penetration roadways leading to a series of unit clusters surrounding parking courts. A greenway connects all units and provides pedestrian access to the various play and recreation areas and the community center. A large playfield for softball is located near the existing apartment complex, and provisions have been made so that the children in these apartments have access to this area. Provisions have been made for emergency vehicle passage between the two penetrator roadways.
D. Macon, Georgia
Site Developer: Macon BREAKTHROUGH Housing Venture
Site Planner: Reynolds, Smith and Hills
Housing Mix: 80 MFHR
42 MFLR 159 SFA 6 SFD
Ownership Pattern: Cooperative, some subsidized.
Formerly an attractive estate with a 6 acre lake located four miles from the center city, this 50 acre site is in a rapidly developing area of Macon. Considered to be the most attractive prototype site, this property is heavily wooded with pine and hardwood trees in a bowl-like contour oriented to the small, central spring-fed lake. The site design places the housing units in small clusters around the high perimeter to retain as many trees as possible.
